headline: Lykos Isle Turns Hottest Front as Weathered Expanse Toll Mounts
war_summary: Three hours on, the map's din has moved. Lykos Isle is now the busiest sheet in the field, seven base actions inside the last two hours and twenty-two across the day, with Fort Guile and The Squall each touched eleven times; its split stands three Warden works to four Colonial. The Weathered Expanse keeps the grimmest ledger, hourly losses now past four thousand between the armies and still climbing, while the Dead Lands follow at nearly half that pace, The Salt March and Callahan's Boot the busiest works there, two more events logged inside the last two hours. Tempest Island stirred anew, four actions inside two hours, Blackwatch its busiest ground. Godcrofts, busiest in our last edition, has filed nothing since mid-morning, all nine works still Warden; Fishermen's Row likewise near seventeen hours silent. Marban Hollow, cooled in the previous report, has flared afresh, and Kings Cage with it. This is the ninety-fifth day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.
